name: ChatGPT
tagline: General-purpose AI chat with GPT models
verdictSummary: You can build a chat UI calling the OpenAI API in 10 minutes. But the moat isn't the UI — it's the models, the fine-tuning infrastructure, the RLHF pipeline, and the multi-modal capabilities.
whatYouLose: GPT-4o model access without API costs
whyPeopleStillPay: Access to the actual models at a fixed monthly price, cheaper than API usage for heavy users
